TABLE SETTINGS

Without a key the DM runs entirely in your browser (downloads a small AI model once). With your free Groq key it uses a far more capable model. The key never leaves this browser.
Used when a Groq key is set. If a model is ever unavailable, the DM automatically falls back to the next one.
In co-pilot mode the AI drafts your private script, moves monsters, and voices NPC lines on your cue — you narrate and decide.
Only used when no Groq key is set. The Smart brain is noticeably better at improvising, but downloads more and runs slower on phones.
If set, the DM uses an ElevenLabs voice instead — the most human-like option. Also stays in this browser.
Always-on listening (no push-to-talk)
DM voiceover narration
💥 Hit markers — floating damage numbers
Background soundscapes and dice sounds. The 🔊 button in the top bar toggles sound on and off.
